entities.name: S. pombe Scr1 (O14335)
observations: Supplied 565-aa sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt O14335 DNA-binding protein scr1.
Scr1 participates in carbon catabolite repression and represses transcription of genes including inv1.
Curated annotations place Scr1 in the nucleus and report RNA polymerase II transcription-repressor and sequence-specific DNA-binding functions.
Sequence analysis finds two zf-C2H2 Pfam matches at residues 26–48 and 54–78; these support a DNA-binding transcription factor architecture.
Predicted unmodified sequence properties: 59,713 Da, pI 10.21, GRAVY -0.570, instability index 66.08; these are estimates, not experimental measurements.
